increment_paragraph: **LINK-STANDING-SELECTION-TWO-CONFIGURATION-KEYS** (named follow-up of LERI-CROSS-UNIT-ELEMENTS-RELEASED; rule 40 amended in place, one sentence of rule 4c; Lean `QCore.CrossUnitSummary` extended; [report](../../reports/link-standing-selection-two-configuration-keys/README.md)). The Fluent Bit system and tail-pause selections keep the static and shared configurations of each core file under one `library/file` key, so rule 40's condition 13 refused every core home. A route configuration is now left out of that count when the link-resolution artifact records it with `linked: false` and every link input's attribution names it nowhere (shown outside the link: the link used nothing it compiles); on a derived run such a configuration also exports and defines nothing in rule 4c's census, so the linked configuration is the key's one home. An unrecorded configuration, one a link input is attributed to (even an input matching two configurations), or an unreadable attribution keeps the refusal. Fixtures: unit tests in `cross_unit_links.rs` (`OUTSIDE_VECTORS` equal to the Lean `outsideVectors`) and the end-to-end `link_standing_two_configurations.rs` (an unlinked `-fPIC` second configuration: caller Safe; attributed or unrecorded: refused, Unknown). Measured on the card's own `prepare --link` preparations (046accf6, upstream 90978ac6), rule 40 quick runs: system 2 to 105 derived homes, slice 62 to 124, condition 13 refusals 103 and 62 to 0, other refusals unchanged; slice rows unchanged (tail_file.c's incomplete census still refuses the import phase); system 15 home exports, 13 imported, no status move, four Unknown rows of the linked configurations lose leaves (flb_engine_dispatch, flb_task_retry_create, task_collect_output_references, handle_output_event). The declared measurement (stated map, system and slice) moved no row, as predicted. Corpus not measured: the pinned route refuses a link-resolution artifact.

ledger.why: DISCHARGED by LINK-STANDING-SELECTION-TWO-CONFIGURATION-KEYS (rule 40 amended in place; Lean QCore.CrossUnitSummary: shownOutside, keyUnique, derivedCensus, an_outside_second_configuration_leaves_the_key, a_usable_second_configuration_refuses, an_outside_second_configuration_admits_the_linked_home, outside_vectors_hold): condition 13 counts only the route configurations the link can use; a configuration the artifact records with linked: false and to which no link input is attributed is shown outside the link and, on a derived run, exports and defines nothing in rule 4c's census; anything else keeps the refusal (fixtures crates/qcore-audit/src/cross_unit_links.rs and crates/qcore-audit/tests/link_standing_two_configurations.rs). Measured (own preparations of 046accf6 and 90978ac6): system 2 -> 105 derived homes, slice 62 -> 124, no condition 13 refusal left; slice rows unchanged (census), system no status move, four Unknown rows lose leaves.

ledger.text: AMENDED by LINK-STANDING-SELECTION-TWO-CONFIGURATION-KEYS: condition 13 no longer refuses the two-configuration core homes; on the system route flb_engine_destroy_tasks is now derived and imported (one of 13 imported homes), so its caller's absence from the system selection is the remaining route-level blocker there.
